steps.description: Cover: wide view of the night market - conveyor with brainrots, lapaks with flags, the character at spawn.
Buying a brainrot: stand by the conveyor and press E on a brainrot's prompt to buy it.
Placed brainrot earning income: a brainrot on a lapak pedestal, HUD shows $/detik ticking up.
Gerobak Tsunami warning: the blue wave banner announces the cart tsunami sweeping the market.
